text:
Pavel Mintyukov had the best night of his season in Edmonton on Nov. 5: two goals and a Gordie Howe hat trick in a 5-4 win (RotoWire, Sportsnet). He's at seven points in 16 games for an Anaheim team that has spent most of the month winning, and he's playing 19 and a half minutes a night.

Some of it will cool. He's shooting 13.3% on just 15 shots, where defensemen with his chances usually sit around 7%, and our range has his point pace drifting back toward a little above one per 60. His own shot volume is low, and his top shot speed sits in the bottom 5%.

What keeps him in the lineup is the puck-moving. The Ducks are almost six points better in shot share with him on, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 52% of his exits leaving the zone with possession last season. The worry is the same one Evolving-Hockey flagged a year ago: opponents got more chances with him on the ice (bottom 11% of defensemen). The 10th pick in 2022 is 22, and the two-way game is the part still being built.
